description: Data owned by a remote system: asynchronous, shared, possibly changed by others and always potentially stale.
Show cached data immediately and refetch in the background, swapping in fresh data when it arrives.
How long data is considered fresh (no refetch) and how long unused cache entries are kept in memory.
Marking cached entries stale after a write so active queries refetch: `invalidateQueries` or RTK Query tags.
Document caches store responses per key (TanStack, RTK Query); normalized caches store entities by id (Apollo, Relay).
